content_units: Best Fit for After-Work Pickup in Auckland
For a parent prioritizing   weekday after-work pickup   and   low prices on common OTC items  ,   FamilyRx Mt Eden   is the strongest overall choice.
It stays open until   7:00 PM on weekdays  , which is meaningfully better for after-work pickup than 6:00 PM, while still keeping prices relatively low at   97/100  .

Pick: FamilyRx Mt Eden
